about.title: ABOUT FLOOFY
about.description: Floofy is a talented illustrator and streamer known for captivating artwork and fun live streams. With a passion for creativity and a unique artistic style, Floofy has built a dedicated following in the art community. Whether through digital illustrations or interactive streaming sessions, Floofy continues to inspire and entertain audiences worldwide.

artist.name: SummerFloofy
artist.short_desc: SummerFloofy is an illustrator and streamer who creates fan arts and original works. From beloved character interpretations to wholly original designs, every piece reflects a warm, expressive style that has captured hearts across the internet.
artist.extended_desc: With a passion for storytelling through art, SummerFloofy brings characters to life with vibrant colors and emotive detail. Streaming regularly on Twitch, they invite the community into the creative process—from rough sketches to polished finals—building a space that's as much about connection as it is about craft.
